record.question: Article 102 of Indian Constitution specifies that a person shall disqualified for contesting elections and being a Member of Parliament if he/she holds any office of profit, is of unsound mind or an undischarged insolvent, is not a citizen of India, or is sentenced to imprisonment for two years or more. Which one of the above is incorrect?
options: is of unsound mind or an undischarged insolvent
is not a citizen of India
is sentenced to imprisonment for two years or more
